parameters.query: SELECT v.project_id, v.token_id, v.valid, v.reason FROM validate_client_token($1, 'project_view') v LIMIT 1;

SELECT json_build_object(
  'project', (SELECT json_build_object('id', p.id, 'name', p.name, 'project_type', p.project_type, 'property_type', p.property_type, 'property_area_m2', p.property_area_m2, 'location', concat_ws(', ', p.location_address, p.location_city, p.location_province), 'budget_target', p.budget_target, 'current_phase', p.current_phase, 'created_at', p.created_at, 'handover_date', p.handover_date) FROM projects p WHERE p.id = $1::uuid),
  'briefing', (SELECT json_build_object('summary', b.summary, 'objectives', b.objectives, 'client_needs', pii_decrypt(b.client_needs_enc)::jsonb, 'constraints', b.constraints, 'rooms_affected', b.rooms_affected, 'status', b.status, 'version', b.version) FROM briefings b WHERE b.project_id = $1::uuid AND b.status='approved' ORDER BY b.version DESC LIMIT 1),
  'design', (SELECT json_build_object('title', d.title, 'description', d.description, 'option_number', d.option_number) FROM design_options d WHERE d.project_id = $1::uuid AND d.is_selected = true LIMIT 1),
  'cost_estimate', (SELECT json_build_object('total_estimated', ce.total_estimated, 'version', ce.version, 'created_at', ce.created_at) FROM cost_estimates ce WHERE ce.project_id = $1::uuid ORDER BY ce.version DESC LIMIT 1),
  'invoices', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('supplier', i.supplier_name, 'date', i.invoice_date, 'total', i.total_amount, 'status', i.status) ORDER BY i.invoice_date DESC NULLS LAST) FROM invoices i WHERE i.project_id = $1::uuid),
  'invoices_summary', (SELECT json_build_object('total', COALESCE(sum(total_amount),0), 'count', count(*), 'pending', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='pending_review'), 'paid', count(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_at IS NOT NULL)) FROM invoices WHERE project_id = $1::uuid),
  'certifications', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('version', c.version, 'percentage', c.percentage, 'amount', c.amount, 'status', c.status, 'paid_amount', c.paid_amount) ORDER BY c.version) FROM certifications c WHERE c.project_id = $1::uuid),
  'aftercare', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('reported_at', a.reported_at, 'severity', a.severity, 'category', a.category, 'description', LEFT(a.description, 200), 'status', a.status, 'assigned_to', a.assigned_to, 'resolved_at', a.resolved_at) ORDER BY a.reported_at DESC) FROM aftercare_incidents a WHERE a.project_id = $1::uuid),
  'pathology', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('type', pf.pathology_type, 'severity', pf.severity, 'description', pf.description, 'recommended_action', pf.recommended_action, 'status', pf.status) ORDER BY CASE pf.severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) FROM pathology_findings pf WHERE pf.project_id = $1::uuid AND pf.status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed')),
  'permits', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('entity', pa.entity, 'application_type', pa.application_type, 'expediente_id', pa.expediente_id, 'status', pa.status, 'submitted_at', pa.submitted_at) ORDER BY pa.created_at DESC) FROM permit_applications pa WHERE pa.project_id = $1::uuid)
) AS snapshot;
